subject: Access to SOC 2 Type II report — NDA required, bridge letter and redaction plan
body:
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@finpay.com
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II report request for procurement

Hi Aditya,

We're moving quickly on the FinPay vendor review and need Redwood's SOC 2 Type II report and any bridge letter that explains the audit period. Procurement has asked that we get the report before next Wednesday's committee meeting.

Quick question: is the SOC2 report gated behind a mutual NDA? If so, can you send the NDA template or steps to request access? Also please confirm the audit period covered by the current Type II.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager | FinPay Inc.
[email signature]

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for procurement

Hi Maria — thanks for the note and the heads up on timing.

Short answer: yes, we share the SOC 2 Type II report under a mutual NDA. We typically require a countersigned mutual NDA before releasing the full report (we can provide a redacted version if you need a quicker view).

Proposed steps:
- I attach our mutual NDA template (attached as: Redwood_NDA_Template.pdf). Please sign & return and I'll send it to Legal to countersign.
- Once countersigned, Security will produce a redacted PDF and a short bridge letter that states the audit period and any coverage notes.
- If you need specific evidence (control-level artifacts), we can coordinate a secured share and limited SSO access.

If procurement is on a tight timeline, we can expedite: return signed NDA today and I'll ask Legal and Security to target delivery by EOD next Tuesday.

Copied Neha from Legal to coordinate countersign and Rishi from Security for redaction plan.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Attachment: Redwood_NDA_Template.pdf (pdf, 28 KB)

---

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Jan 2026 14:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for procurement

Thanks Aditya — attaching our standard signed mutual NDA (NDA_FinPay_signed.pdf). Please countersign on your end and confirm receipt.

A few clarifying Qs from procurement/security:
- We need the audit period clearly stated in the bridge letter (start-end).
- Redactions are acceptable, but we need a short redaction summary so reviewers understand what was removed.
- Can you confirm who will be copied on the delivery (legal/security contact at Redwood)?

Can you confirm expected delivery ETA after countersign? We can escalate if needed.

Attached: NDA_FinPay_signed.pdf

Best,
Maria

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 11 Jan 2026 09:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: NDA from FinPay — countersign and redaction/bridge plan?

Neha, Rishi — forwarding FinPay's signed NDA. Can Legal countersign and return the countersigned PDF to Maria, and can Security prepare a redacted SOC 2 PDF plus a short bridge letter stating the audit period and any relevant notes?

Procurement timeline: they asked for delivery by next Wednesday (2026-01-14) but they'd accept EOD 2026-01-15 with escalation.

Key asks from FinPay:
- Bridge letter with audit period (they need the dates).
- Short redaction summary that lists categories redacted (IPs, specific vendor names, sample IDs).

Please reply with confirmation and the target ETA. I'm happy to coordinate the DocuSign link and procurement ticket.

Thanks — Aditya

---

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 12 Jan 2026 11:20:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NDA from FinPay — countersign and redaction/bridge plan?

Thanks Aditya. 

Security will prepare a redacted version of the SOC 2 Type II report with minimal necessary redactions. Planned redactions:
- IP and product architecture diagrams (high-level descriptions retained).
- Third-party vendor contact details and sample identifiers.
- Customer-specific anecdotal examples.

We'll include a redaction_summary.txt describing the categories and count of redacted items.

Bridge letter: I'll draft a short bridge letter confirming the audit period (2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30) and clarifying that there were no material exceptions within the period we tested. The bridge letter will be a single-page PDF.

ETA: countersigned NDA and bridge letter by Tue 2026-01-13 EOD; redacted SOC2 by Fri 2026-01-15 EOD. If FinPay needs earlier access, we can provide a high-level summary today for their procurement committee.

Neha — please confirm legal countersignature on the attached NDA (I recommend minimal edits).

— Rishi
Chief Information Security Officer | Redwood Inference

---

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 13 Jan 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: NDA from FinPay — countersign and redaction/bridge plan?

I've reviewed FinPay's signed NDA. No material legal issues; I'll countersign with a standard clause addition around data handling and return the countersigned PDF.

Will send countersigned NDA to Maria directly and copy Aditya.

— Neha
Sr. Counsel, Commercial | Redwood Inference

Attachment: NDA_Redwood_Countersigned.pdf (pdf, 34 KB)

---

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finpay.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jan 2026 16:40:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for procurement

Hi Maria — thanks for returning the NDA. Attached are the items per FinPay's request:

Attachments (secure link / attached):
- NDA_Redwood_Countersigned.pdf (mutual NDA, countersigned by Redwood Legal)
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2024_REDACTED.pdf (redacted copy of the SOC 2 Type II report)
- SOC2_Bridge_Letter_2025-07-01_to_2026-06-30.pdf (one-page bridge letter confirming audit period)
- redaction_summary.txt (short list of categories redacted)

Notes:
- Audit period in the bridge letter is 2025-07-01 to 2026-06-30. The bridge letter states there were no material exceptions impacting controls in scope.
- Redactions are limited to what Security outlined (IP diagrams, vendor contact details, sample IDs). The redaction summary lists the redaction categories and counts.
- If procurement requires any additional signed attestation, let us know and we can route through Legal.

Delivery options: we can provide the files via a time-limited secure share (preferred) or DocuSign-encrypted transfer. See DocuSign link below if you prefer: https://app.docusign.com/envelope/EXAMPLE12345

If everything looks good, please confirm receipt so I can close the procurement ticket (PROC-412).

Best regards,
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference

---

From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@finpay.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jan 2026 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II report request for procurement

Aditya — received the countersigned NDA, bridge letter, redacted SOC2, and redaction summary. Everything looks sufficient for the committee; appreciate the quick turnaround.

I'll mark PROC-412 as ready and loop back if the committee requests further evidence.

Thanks,
Maria Lopez
Sr. Vendor Risk Manager | FinPay Inc.

[End of thread]
